name: io.github.zaka337/sitepulse
description: Check a website's health: security headers, SEO, performance, accessibility and broken links.

environmentVariables.name: SITEPULSE_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the server scan localhost and private-network addresses (for checking a site you are developing). Off by default so an assistant cannot be steered into probing your internal network.
